object.attr: as implemented: USAGE.md, Keyboard shortcuts in the Document Editor. The action is EDIT's; the key is listed here with the window's other keys, so that no two actions share one. Ctrl+L and Ctrl+T are MELLON-TRACE-SRS-16 and -177.
object.description: When the user presses Ctrl+N in a Document Editor, the Document Editor shall run New sibling.
